about: The course library as every page shows it (scripts/site-blocks.mjs). A live course links to its page; a planned one says Planned, links nowhere and names no date. Every video slot is a src that is null until the video exists: set it (a path under /media/ or a full https URL) and run node scripts/build-pages.mjs, and the slot plays it. The planned courses are the five pillars of the content calendar (HubriconB2B-content: docs/content/hubricon-30-day-content-calendar.md); their lessons are its episodes.
